name: Deps Audit
description: 依赖漏洞扫描：唤起 osv-scanner 扫描工作区，列出 OSV 数据库中的依赖漏洞，让 Agent 给出升级或修复 patch。

en.name: Deps Audit
en.description: Dependency vulnerability audit: invoke osv-scanner over the workspace, list known OSV matches, and let the Agent propose a fix or upgrade.
en.safetyNotes: Reads workspace manifest files (package.json, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml, go.mod, pom.xml, *.gemspec) in read-only mode through the host fs.read permission gateway. Spawns the local osv-scanner binary (no network calls from the plugin itself — osv-scanner fetches the OSV database on its own). Writes nothing. The plugin surfaces a vulnerability list to the work panel; selecting one and asking the Agent to fix is always an explicit user action, never automatic.

zh-CN.name: 依赖审计
zh-CN.description: 依赖漏洞扫描：唤起 osv-scanner 扫描工作区，列出 OSV 数据库中的依赖漏洞，让 Agent 给出升级或修复 patch。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 以只读方式经宿主 fs.read 权限网关读取工作区 manifest 文件（package.json、requirements.txt、Cargo.toml、go.mod、pom.xml、*.gemspec）。spawn 本机 osv-scanner 二进制（插件本身不发起任何网络请求，OSV 数据库由 osv-scanner 自己拉取）。不写入任何文件。漏洞列表在面板中只读展示；选中并请 Agent 修复永远是用户的显式动作，永不自动发生。

changelog: Release 0.1.0：首个公开版本。唤起 osv-scanner 扫描工作区 manifest（package.json / requirements.txt / Cargo.toml / go.mod / pom.xml / *.gemspec / pyproject.toml / composer.json），按严重度聚合 OSV 数据库匹配结果；面板只读展示，发现选中后生成可复制给 Agent 的修复询问文本（永不自动应用）。Agent 工具 deps_audit_run（risk low）按需触发扫描。
safetyNotes: 只读扫描工作区 manifest；spawn 本机 osv-scanner 二进制（插件本身不发网络请求，OSV 数据库由 osv-scanner 自取）；不写任何文件；选中漏洞请 Agent 修复需用户显式操作。
author: muzimu217

agentTools.name: deps_audit_run
agentTools.description: Run an OSV-Scanner audit on the workspace's dependency manifests. Returns a structured vulnerability list (ecosystem, package, installed version, fix versions, advisory links). The Agent must not auto-apply any fix — only summarize and propose; the user applies.

manifests.description: Restrict to these manifest types; empty = all detected.

severity_min.description: Filter: only show findings at or above this severity.

settings.title: osv-scanner binary path
settings.description: 绝对路径或 PATH 中的可执行名。留空则按 PATH 查找 osv-scanner。

settings.title: Severity filter
settings.description: 仅显示达到该等级及以上的漏洞。
